name: Matte
reference: Studio product renders (ManvsMachine, Buck): a matte object on a dark floor, one metal tone, a camera orbit.
pattern: Very dark grey, matte dark objects, one champagne metal tone.
personality: Material. The object turns under a passing light; type is small and quiet.

motion.character: A slow orbit and a light that passes across the surface; macro moves.
motion.transitions: A cut on the beat, or the light sweep becomes the next scene.

texture.note: Matte surfaces and a specular edge, and a soft reflection in the floor. No gradient environment.

grammar: The product is the subject, on a floor with a soft reflection.
Type is small, in a corner.
needs: A 3D model or a product render. Deferred: needs real materials.

pictures.note: The object is a 3D render (the product block); a photo, if any, is warm, muted and dark.

footage.note: Slow material close-ups, warm and dark.

music.feel: cinematic ambient texture, low drones, tactile

hits.note: A soft swell as the light crosses the object.

hook.how: The object on its floor on frame 0, lit, with a slow orbit running. An object with mass (a chair, a vessel, a body), not a thin one: its silhouette covers the share (product frames by it), so the middle and lower frame are the object and its reflection.

compose.how: The line small, in a corner: the smallest role that keeps the phone floor (headline), left on the text-safe top (Matte's type is small and quiet); the product under it, framed with `room`: the frame under the line, a body line height below it, so the object, its shadow and its reflection own the middle and lower frame. Set the line first, left-aligned; the room under it keeps the object clear of it by construction: never on the handle or the rim. The anchor `<product id>-object-extent` holds the object's drawn bounds over the shot, to check the gap.

moves.move: A light passes across the matte surface once per shot.

measurable.how: A bright band moves across the object over 30-60 frames.

moves.move: A tight contact shadow where the object meets the floor, and a soft, matte reflection of it in the floor (reflection).
A rim line draws the silhouette on the dark ground.
Macro shots frame a detail that explains the object, 40-60 % of the frame.

props.fill: leave it out: the default fills the hook's share of the frame
props.frame: "detail" with detail: { point, span } for a macro of one part (the 3D camera moves in; the bleed is declared)
props.material: a real model keeps its own ("own", the default); roles ("system") only for a form drawn from simple geometry

blocks.for: The object, its light, its shadow and its rim.

props.role: "headline" for the one line of each beat (it must read on a phone); "label" only for a spec or a credit beside the object

blocks.for: The line of each beat, and small type in a corner.
A bed entered at a section with an audible pulse.
A soft swell as the light crosses.
The name beside the object, held.

avoid.why: Matte is a render; a photo breaks the material.
Type is small, in a corner.

wanted.name: endCard beside an object
wanted.for: The name aligned to the object's top or centre line; endCard centres its lockup in a box the scene gives.

ends.how: A clean front view on a strong accent, the name beside the object, held. In a wide or square frame the name sits beside the object (a row); at 9:16 a large object cannot sit beside a name, so endCard sets the name over it (a column). The end card shows the model at its own turn: give its mark `{ objects }` with `rotation: [0, 0, 0]` on the object (its front), or the turn that shows its front.
ends.with: `name`, `axis: "row"` (a column at 9:16), `at` on the last strong onset

mix.note: Low drones; enter where the pulse is audible, so the first cut lands on a sound.

shots.match: One object, one floor and one light rig; the camera changes, not the material.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a floating sphere with no product
